.github/workflows/farm3d-regression.yml.before:
name: Sunny Acres 3D regression

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'farm3d/**'
      - '.github/workflows/farm3d-regression.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: farm3d-regression-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  utility-lights:
    name: Farm Utility real lighting + native touch + offline saves
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: farm3d/tests/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
        working-directory: farm3d/tests
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
        working-directory: farm3d/tests
      - name: Utility ownership, geometry, light budget and cache contracts
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/utility-lights"
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/farm3d/tests/helpers/ci-isolated-runner.cjs" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/utility-lights/step-1.json" --timeout-ms 1200000 --max-output-bytes 16777216 -- bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail -c 'node --test farm3d/tests/save-writer-compatibility.test.mjs farm3d/tests/utility-lights.test.mjs farm3d/tests/decor-models.test.mjs farm3d/tests/decor-save.test.mjs farm3d/tests/holiday-decor.test.mjs farm3d/tests/holiday-clearings.test.mjs farm3d/tests/versions.test.mjs'
      - name: Real illuminated farm, trusted input, GPU ownership and installed51to52 update
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/utility-lights"
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/farm3d/tests/helpers/ci-isolated-runner.cjs" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/utility-lights/step-2.json" --timeout-ms 1200000 --max-output-bytes 16777216 -- bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail -c 'node farm3d/tests/utility-lights.browser.cjs'
      - name: Preserve actual night captures, partial results and failure traces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: utility-lights-${{ github.run_attempt }}-execution-receipts-only
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/a52-ci-safe/utility-lights/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

name: Sunny Acres release qualification
on:

    branches: [main]

      - 'farm3d/firebase/tests/conflicts.browser.cjs'
      - 'farm3d/firebase/tests/emu-harness.cjs'
      - 'farm3d/firebase/package*.json'
      - 'farm3d/firebase/firestore.rules'

      - 'farm3d/index.html'

    inputs:
      qualification_set:
        description: Select all checks, cache/recovery, or the A31 recovery-only diagnostic

  contents: read

  conflicts:
    name: Same-account conflicting saves (emulator)
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.qualification_set == 'all' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 20

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

          distribution: temurin

          node-version: '22'

        working-directory: farm3d/firebase
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Install Chromium and system dependencies
        working-directory: farm3d/firebase
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Preserve both farms through stale-upload refusal and user choices

        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/conflicts"
